One of the highlights of attending NIC for Rikki was winning a Molstead Family Memorial Scholarship. She graduated as an honor student with a 3.8 GPA in 2015, with an AAS in Paralegal Studies. Rikki enjoys hanging out with friends, cooking and baking, reading, watching classic movies, and taking in the beautiful scenery in North Idaho.
